$schema.description: URL or path of this schema

modules.description: Module graph generated by "caffeine generate modules"

include.description: Globs, relative to the project directory, naming the sources to read

exclude.description: Globs removed from the include set, such as bootstrap files and tests

root.description: Directory the module graph is rooted at, where the root module is written

importExtension.description: Extension the generated import specifiers carry

depth.description: Folder depth, below the root, at which a module is formed

depths.description: Per-folder overrides of depth, keyed by the folder path below the root

maxDepth.description: Folder depth beyond which sources are left out of the graph

skip.description: Folder paths, below the root, that form no module

tsconfig.description: tsconfig.json consulted to resolve path-alias imports for the needs graph, relative to the project directory; only consulted if it exists
